brand.tagline: Writers find their way. Readers find their writers.

language.changeLater: You can change the language anytime in Settings.

common.comingSoon: Coming soon. We're still building this part of Lisette.

auth.name: Name
auth.readerFirst: Everyone starts as a reader. You can add a writer profile anytime.
auth.verifyBody: We sent a confirmation link to {{email}}. Open it to finish creating your account.
auth.recoverBody: Enter your email and we’ll send you a link to set a new password.
auth.recoverySent: If an account exists for {{email}}, we sent it a link to set a new password.

roles.writerBody: Keep your reader library and add a space for your manuscripts, excerpts and published work.
roles.manuscriptsPrivate: Manuscripts stay private until you choose publishers
roles.roleDisclaimer: A writer profile is a role in Lisette. It doesn't verify your identity or certify authorship.
roles.title: Your role

status.onHoldExplain: The publisher is still considering your submission.
status.selectedExplain: The publisher would like to discuss next steps and will contact you directly.

manuscripts.withdrawConfirm: Copies already downloaded outside Lisette cannot be recalled.
manuscripts.title: Manuscripts
manuscripts.privacyBanner: Private. Only you and the publishers you choose can open your manuscripts.
manuscripts.validPdf: This file is a valid PDF.
manuscripts.invalidPdf: This file isn't a valid PDF. Lisette accepts PDF manuscripts only.
manuscripts.noEditor: Lisette doesn't edit manuscripts. Make changes in your own editor, then upload the new PDF here.
manuscripts.hashRecord: We record this file's hash and upload time. That's a record of this version, not proof of authorship.
manuscripts.deviceAuthHint: Use your fingerprint or phone PIN.
manuscripts.previewReadOnly: Read-only. This is the version you're about to send.
manuscripts.tooLarge: This file is larger than 20 MB. Lisette accepts manuscripts up to 20 MB.
manuscripts.deleteDisabled: Already sent. The publication keeps the version it received.
manuscripts.confirmDeleteBody: Its versions and files will disappear from Lisette. This cannot be undone.
manuscripts.noManuscripts: Upload a PDF from your editor and keep it here privately.
manuscripts.versionDeleteBody: The file will disappear from Lisette. This cannot be undone.

reader.progress: Where you are in the manuscript
reader.noText: This PDF is scanned, so it has no text to lay out on screen. The original pages stay.
reader.failed: We couldn't open the manuscript. Try again later.

submit.alreadyActive: Already in review with this work.
submit.sharingAuthorControlled: Sharing: author-controlled. You decide what readers see.
submit.sharingApproval: Sharing: synopsis and excerpt approval. Before readers see a synopsis or excerpt from this work, {{publisher}} approves the exact text.
submit.contactBody: Your email {{email}} and phone {{phone}} will be shared with the publications you selected so they can contact you directly. They won't appear publicly or be used for marketing.
submit.agreeContact: I agree to share my contact details
submit.declaration: I confirm that I wrote this manuscript, or have permission from all rights holders to submit it and share the selected material.
submit.firstSent: Your first submission is on its way.
submit.didntSendBody: Nothing was sent to {{publisher}}. Your manuscript is still saved.
submit.unknownResult: We couldn't confirm this one. Try again: if it already arrived, it won't be sent twice.
submit.noOpenCalls: No open calls match these filters.
submit.title: Send your manuscript
submit.phoneMissing: Add a phone number to your contact details before sending.
submit.missingRights: To send, tick the rights declaration.
submit.missingContact: To send, agree to share your contact details.
submit.missingRules: To send, accept the sharing rules.
submit.reason_not_owner: This manuscript isn't yours to send.
submit.reason_blocked: You can't send to this publication.
submit.reason_duplicate_active: Already in review with this work.
submit.reason_resubmission_not_allowed: This publication doesn't take this work again.
submit.reason_missing_phone: Add a phone number to your contact details, then try again.
submit.reason_missing_consent: Tick the declaration and the contact agreement.
submit.reason_invalid_material: One of the materials couldn't be used. Start a new send to choose it again.
submit.reason_invalid_genre: This call needs a different genre. Start a new send to choose it.
submit.materialUploadUnknown: We couldn't confirm the upload. Choose the file again.
submit.sharingSynopsisApproval: Sharing: synopsis approval. Before readers see a synopsis from this work, {{publisher}} approves the exact text.
submit.versionIntro: Choose the version to send to every selected call.
submit.noManuscripts: You have no manuscript to send yet. Upload one in Manuscripts, then come back to this call.
submit.callClosed: The call you started from isn't open anymore. You can still choose other calls.
submit.materialsIntro: You give each material once. It goes only to the calls that ask for it.
submit.allSent_one: Your manuscript is on its way to {{count}} publication.
submit.allSent_other: Your manuscript is on its way to {{count}} publications.

submission.copyImmutable: This copy stays as sent. New versions don't change it.
submission.withdrawExplain: Withdrawing ends {{publisher}}'s access to this submission in Lisette. Copies they already downloaded can't be recalled. Your other submissions aren't affected.

publisher.accessEnded: Access to this submission has ended.
publisher.onHoldHint: Still considering. Reading stays on, download stays off.
publisher.selectHint: You'd like to discuss next steps with the author. Not a contract.
publisher.rejectHint: Final. Your access to this manuscript ends.
publisher.evaluationPrivate: Private to you and the author. Required to select.
publisher.contactDirect: You'll contact {{author}} directly using the email and phone they shared with you.
publisher.downloadOff: Download is off while this submission is on hold. Reading in Lisette stays on.
publisher.callsEmpty: No calls yet. Create one to start receiving manuscripts.
publisher.dateHint: YYYY-MM-DD. Leave empty to start today.
publisher.deadlineHint: YYYY-MM-DD. The call closes at the end of that day.
publisher.cancelledReadOnly: Cancelled. This call can no longer be changed.
publisher.invalidDate: Check the date. Write it as YYYY-MM-DD.
publisher.cancelConfirm: Press again to cancel. Authors can no longer send to this call, and it can't be reopened.
publisher.deadlineBeforeStart: The deadline must come after the start.

community.feedSubtitle: Posts from the accounts you follow, in the order they appeared.
community.composerPrompt: What are you writing or reading today?
community.emptyTitle: All quiet on the shelf for now
community.emptyBody: The accounts you follow haven't posted anything new. You can look for authors, readers and publishers.
community.bodyLabel: What do you want to say?
community.publicNote: Posts are public to people on Lisette.
community.limitsNote: One image; a large one is scaled down automatically. Text can be up to {{chars}} characters.
community.linkHint: You choose the linked book. Lisette doesn't guess it from the text.
community.searchHint: Only public works can be linked.
community.excerptNote: For an excerpt from a manuscript, choose the Fragment tab above.
community.postEmpty: Write something or add an image.
community.sourceUnavailable: The original post is no longer available.
community.notAllowed: This action isn't available for this post.
community.imagePrepareFailed: The chosen image couldn't be opened. Try another image.
community.imageUploadFailed: An image couldn't be uploaded, so the post wasn't published. Try again.
community.deleteBody: Nobody will see it again, you included.
community.reactHint: Tap to choose a reaction, or press and slide your finger over them.

sharing.title: Sharing and approvals
sharing.explanation: Only approved exact text can be published. A changed text needs fresh approval.
sharing.author: Author
sharing.rangeError: Choose a range from 1 to {{pages}} with the start no later than the end.
sharing.wholeRangeError: Choose less than the whole manuscript.
sharing.noWorks: You have no manuscript or book to share from yet. Upload a manuscript and come back here.
sharing.rangeHint: Type the first and last page you want to show, for example 3 – 7, or pick the pages straight from the PDF.
sharing.pagesFailed: We couldn't open these pages. Try again later.

beta.title: Beta-readers
beta.readOnly: You can read these pages in Lisette. Downloading isn't available.

patterns.title: Reading patterns
patterns.basedOn_one: Based on {{count}} reader who chose to share reading patterns
patterns.basedOn_other: Based on {{count}} readers who chose to share reading patterns
patterns.belowThreshold: Patterns appear once enough readers have chosen to share them.
patterns.notQuality: Patterns, not a measure of quality.
patterns.optInTitle: Share your reading patterns with authors?
patterns.optInBody: If you agree, authors see where readers linger in their excerpts. They never see your name. Choose below how you're included. You can stop anytime in Settings.
patterns.noiseSwitch: Include the noise level around me
patterns.noiseBody: Measured on your phone only. Lisette never records, keeps or sends audio.
patterns.levelStandard: Only together with at least 10 readers
patterns.levelStandardHint: Your patterns count only once 10 or more readers share theirs.
patterns.levelNoThresholdHint: Your patterns can appear even if you're one of very few readers. The author won't see your name, but may be able to tell how you read.

library.title: Library
library.privateBanner: Your library is private. You choose which books appear on your profile.
library.showOnProfileOff: Off. Only you see this book.
library.scanHint: Point the camera at the barcode on the back cover.
library.scanSteady: Hold the book steady, in good light.
library.scanFailed: We couldn't scan that barcode. Try again, or add the book by hand.
library.scanCardHint: Point the camera at the ISBN barcode on the back of the book.
library.emptyShelfBody: Scan a barcode or add a book by hand.
library.followedTitle: What the authors you follow are reading
library.cameraOffBody: Lisette needs the camera to scan barcodes. You can also add books by hand.
library.lookingUp: Looking up the book by ISBN
library.staysPrivate: The book stays private until you choose to show it on your profile.
library.isbnNotFound: We couldn't find this book by its ISBN. Add the title and author.
library.isbnUnavailable: Looking up books by ISBN isn't working right now. You can add the book by hand.
library.isbnInvalid: This ISBN doesn't look right. Check the digits or leave it empty.
library.similarBody: Lisette already has similar books. Pick yours, or add it as a new book.
library.showOnProfileOn: On. The book appears on your profile.
library.inspirationHint: A book that inspired you as an author.
library.removeTitle: Remove this book from your library?
library.removeBody: The book stays on Lisette. Only your entry goes.
library.privateWork: A private project can't appear on your profile.
library.notInLibrary: This book is no longer in your library.
library.savedWithoutIsbn: Book saved without its ISBN, because we couldn't check it right now.
library.notBookBarcode: This isn't a book's ISBN. Look for the barcode that starts with 978 or 979, usually on the back cover.
library.isbnUnavailableTitle: We couldn't check the ISBN right now. Write the title to add the book.
library.isbnChecksum: These digits don't form a valid ISBN. Check them.
library.isbnValid: Valid ISBN. You can leave the title empty: we'll look it up.
library.isbnHeld: Book saved without the ISBN: it already belongs to the book we showed you.

events.intentNote: This shows your interest. It isn't a ticket or a booking.

discoveries.label: Literary discovery
discoveries.hiddenUntilHere: The text and images stay hidden until you're here.
discoveries.closeEnough: You're close enough to unlock it.
discoveries.tooFar: You need to be at this place to unlock it.
discoveries.locationOnce: Uses your location once, when you tap. No background tracking.
discoveries.unlocked: Unlocked. It's in your discoveries now, to reopen from anywhere.
discoveries.unavailable: This discovery is no longer available.

notifications.betaInvite: {{author}} shared pages with you as a beta-reader

settings.title: Settings
settings.readingThemeAuto: Adjust to the light around me
settings.appLock: Lock manuscripts with fingerprint or PIN
settings.unblockNote: Unblocking doesn't restore earlier follows or reactions.

errors.network: You seem to be offline. Check your connection and try again.
errors.uploadUnknown: We couldn't confirm the upload. Check your manuscripts before trying again.
errors.sendFailed: Your submission didn't send. Your saved manuscript is still available. Try sending it again.
errors.permissionCamera: Lisette needs the camera to scan barcodes. You can still add books by hand.
errors.permissionLocation: Lisette needs your location once to unlock a discovery. You can still browse the map.
errors.invalidCredentials: The email or password isn’t right.
errors.emailNotConfirmed: Confirm your email first. Look for the link in your inbox.
errors.passwordTooShort: Use at least 10 characters for your password.
errors.invalidEmail: This email address doesn’t look right.
